name: server-list
title: Server List
description: A List over a PageSource that grows as you scroll: ListItem rows, virtualized past 200, one tab stop with row navigation, the next page when the end comes into view, and a visible Load more button for keyboards and agents.
docs: `<ServerList aria-label source renderItem itemText labels={{ errorTitle, retry, emptyTitle }} />`, with `renderItem` returning a `ListItem`. It pages with `useServerInfinite`, by page number or cursor, `pageSize` (50) rows at a time. With `infinite` (default) the next page loads as the end of the list scrolls into view; the Load more button is always there too, so keyboards and agents reach every page, and it keeps focus while it loads and once there is no more. `DataState` covers loading, error with retry and empty, the list is `aria-busy` while a new search loads, and a polite status says "Showing 1–50 of 312" after each load ("Loading…" only past 400 ms). `filters` takes a schema (a `FilterSearch` by default, or your own `toolbar`), and the `List` props (`variant`, `value`, `onValueChange`, `onSelect`, `virtualize`, `estimateSize`) pass through. Agents select rows through the list's `select(id)` and press Load more. Its counts follow `<html lang>` through `useLocale`; `locale` overrides it.
